name: Melvy
source:
A dark elf princess who believes in evil spirits. 
She behaves like a queen with a joyful, arrogant and selfish personality.
She has taken away treasures, destroying past countries out of frustration and lust for power.
Although the dark elves are a type of elves, they hate the high elves who have power and who have expelled dark elves from the forest due to Iris barrier.
Because the dark elves don't breed by sexual activity, they are virgins.
She is the first heroine to fall into the MC hands.
